 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Mohit Kumar Shah
 Oral Order

The present writ petition has been filed seeking the following reliefs:-
"1(i).

For Setting aside the entire proceeding initiated by the District Public Grievance Redressal Officer, Siwan with respect to Compliant No. 4161101204032203633 including notice dated 01-04-2021 as well as order dated 04-04-2022, and all subsequent proceeding and orders as the initiation of proceeding against the private persons on complaint by the private person is wholly without jurisdiction in terms of Section 2 of the Patna High Court CWJC No.8487 of 2022(4) dt.21-04-2023 Bihar Right to Public Grievance Redressal Act. 2015.
(ii). For a further direction to the senior officer of the state of Bihar to initiate a Departmental Proceeding against the District Public Grievance Redressal Officer,

Siwan who in connivance with the private respondent is considering a pure family dispute de-horse the rule, in teeth of Bihar Right to Public Grievance Redressal Act,
2005 and further the said authority by exceeding his jurisdiction misbehaving.

sentences.text: threatening, abusing and terrorizing the petitioner on all the dates for fulfillment of illegal demand of private respondent and further be pleased to award exemplary punishment, besides launching a criminal prosecution for his misconduct which is an officer in terms of Indian Penal Code and Prevention of Corruption Act.

(iii). For setting aside the order dated 01.07.2022 passed by the District Public Grievance Redressal officer, Siwan in Complaint 4161101204032203633 whereby the petitioner has been held guilty for misusing Banking process with ill motive to cheat his brothers as well as sisters and the District Public Grievance Redressal Officer,
Siwan further observed that the complaint Manoj Kumar may collect evidence available on record and take action against the petitioner Patna High Court CWJC No.8487 of 2022(4) dt.21-04-2023 Vinod Kumar.

He further orally directed for institution of FIR and consequently the complainant Manoj Kumar collected materials from the record of the said case and instituted a First Information Report bearing Siwan Mufasil P.S. Case No. 391 of 2022 for the offences under Section 420/406/467/120B of the Indian Penal Code, not only against the petitioner but also against his wife and son."

At the outset, the learned counsel for the parties jointly submit that the impugned order dated 1.7.2022, passed by the District Public Grievance Redressal Officer, Siwan, has already been withdrawn, hence, nothing survives for consideration in the present writ petition.
Accordingly, the present writ petition stands disposed off as not pressed.

(Mohit Kumar Shah, J) Ajay/-
